mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may compromise immune function and increase risk of opportunistic infections in immunocompromised patients receiving atovaquone; atovaquone absorption is reduced by concurrent medications affecting GI pH and motility.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and sodium levels, and ensure adequate atovaquone absorption by monitoring therapeutic efficacy; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant electrolyte disturbances occur.
